title: Cohomology over opens sheafifies to the cohomology sheaf
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space and let $K$ be an object of $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology] [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For every integer $q$, the presheaf on open subsets of $X$ given by $U\mapsto H^q(U,K)$ has sheafification canonically isomorphic to the cohomology sheaf $H^q(K)$. Consequently, every element of the stalk $H^q(K)_x$ is represented by some section in $H^q(U,K)$ for an open neighborhood $U$ of $x$, and a representative whose germ is zero becomes zero after restricting to a smaller neighborhood of $x$.
